source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your Movement phase, when a REGIMENT unit of yours that is ASTRA MILITARUM disembarks from a TRANSPORT positioned no more than 6" from this model, this model may give that unit 1 Order straight after the unit is placed, regardless of the Orders it has already given this turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
